intro: A Husband's Revenge is the conclusion to a tragic tale of past betrayal carried into undeath. Raleigh Andrean, a Forsaken residing in the Undercity, charges travelers with tracking down his former friend Valdred Moray, who murdered his wife in life.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Valdred, once my good friend, was my wife's murderer. Although I am incapable of grieving, I do yearn for revenge. If you kill Valdred and bring me his cursed hands, then I will reward you.
I last heard he was at the Greymane Wall in southern Silverpine, trying to flee into the kingdom of Gilneas.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do you have those hands, friend?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, good. These hands killed my wife, Deliah. Revenge for her murder was my only care, and you were the instrument of that revenge.

Here, take the ring you returned earlier. Deliah has been dead to me for so long, her ring is a bauble I no longer care to keep. Instead, I will keep these hands as a remembrance of my friend's betrayal.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
